Why is this formula superior?
The amount of active trans-resveratrol is key.

Ours: contains a clinical dose, 100 mg of active trans-resveratrol.
Others: typically contain low or trace amounts and often do not specifically state the amount of active trans-resveratrol.
Our formula contains Pterostilbene, an antioxidant naturally found in blueberries. Pterostilbene has been shown in laboratory tests to work synergistically with trans-resveratrol to provide enhanced antioxidant properties for anti-aging benefits.

Member's Mark Resveratol Plus+ has been formulated to promote cardiovascular health and to provide superior antioxidant protection.
Made famous by the studies on red wine, Resveratrol has been discovered to be of important benefit to your health.
Member's Mark Resveratol Plus+ contains Polygonum cuspidatum and Vitis vinifera, in order to provide you with the benefits of Resveratrol in a small, concentrated dosage.
Suggested Use: As a dietary supplement, take one capsule daily with a meal.
For adults only. Consult your doctor before taking any supplement.
This product is not derived from, nor does it contain, red wine.
